title: 1970: 1,972 HOURS
subtitle: Hours worked in a year by the average worker

lines.say: In 1970, the average German worker put in 1,972 hours a year. Almost exactly what a worker in Croatia does today.
Now watch the German working year.
By 2023, it was down to 1,335 hours. A third shorter.
Greece fell much less, from 2,114 hours to 1,893.
Richer countries tend to buy back their time. Who works the longest now? It's in our full video.
